_note: Research file (not read by pages, except points and source link on the practice-set page): the structure of the exams our own practice sets follow, checked by scripts/check-pruefungen.mjs (same modules, same parts, same number of scored items per part). Ids are storage keys and stay: goethe-a1…c2 = DELE A1…C2 (goethe-a1 and goethe-c2 have no set in this file's sense: A1 lives in the start-deutsch-1 slot, C2 has no practice set), telc-a2…c1 = the SIELE tasks at each band: together those four sets hold every task of one SIELE Global (the real exam is one multilevel sitting, not band papers). The testdaf slot has its own shape and is described in testdaf-formate.json. Only structure is described; no exam task or text is copied. Field conventions: minutes = paper time; items = scored items in OUR set, modelled on the best public information we found; plays = how often the recording is heard; points = marks where known. Every DELE fact here is 'to verify': see `unverified` in each entry and reports/exams-dele.md. SIELE entries were checked against the official exam guide and siele.org on 2026-11-06, see reports/exams-siele.md.

exams.exam: SIELE: the A1 and A2 tasks
exams.source: SIELE exam pages (siele.org/examenes, siele.org/reconocimiento-internacional) and the SIELE exam guide, Guía para la realización del examen SIELE, copy on seul.cervantes.es, checked 2026-11-06

parts.task: Reading task 1 (A1): five short texts, 40–80 words each
parts.type: Multiple choice, 3 options, one question per text

parts.task: Reading task 2 (A2): one text, 250–300 words
Listening task 1 (A1): a conversation, 150–170 words
parts.type: Complete sentences from a shared bank of 15 options

parts.task: Listening task 2 (A2): information, 250–300 words
Writing task 1 (A1–B1): reply to a letter, email, forum or blog message
Speaking task 1 (A1–A2): four personal questions
Speaking task 2 (A2): describe one of two photos

exams.totalNote: In the real test each of the four tests counts up to 250 points, 1000 in SIELE Global. This set has no points of its own.
exams.pass: No pass mark. Each test gets a score from 0 to 250, matched to a CEFR level; a score below the A1 band reaches no level.
exams.modularNote: SIELE Global is all four tests; S1 to S5 are combinations of them.
unverified: The guide copy has no date we could read; a copy elsewhere is labelled April 2021. Tasks, question counts, times and score bands agree with siele.org/examenes as read on 6 November 2026 where that page gives them, but they may have changed. To verify.
Minutes per module and the split into bands are ours, not the exam's: the real SIELE is one sitting per test and doesn't have band papers.
